description_en: This API is used to obtain end-to-end metric data.
description_zh: 本接口用于获取端对端指标数据
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-end-point-metric-data --app-id testappid --channel-id testid --created-ts 1614936817 --destroyed-ts 1614936817 --sub-user-id testuserid --pub-user-id testuserid2 --pub-call-id-list testcall1,testcall2 --metrics VIDEO_STUCK_CAMERA --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEndPointMetricData

parameters.help_en: Start Time of the query time range. This time must not be earlier than the actual Creation Time of the channel and must not be more than 30 days ago. It is represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间区间的开始时间，该时间不得早于频道实际的创建时间，不得早于30天之前。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: created_ts

parameters.help_en:
End Time of the query time range. This time must not be later than the channel release time. It is represented as a UNIX timestamp, in seconds. If the parameter is empty, the current time is used.

> If the provided End Time exceeds the channel release time, data from the Start Time to the channel release time will be returned, with a maximum duration of the most recent 3 hours
parameters.help_zh:
查询时间区间的结束时间，该时间不得晚于频道释放时间。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空，表示获取当前时间。

> 如果传入的结束时间超过频道的释放时间，将返回从开始时间开始到频道释放时间之间的数据，且最多返回最近3个小时的数据
parameters.name: destroyed_ts

parameters.help_en:
User ID of the publisher.  
> You can specify either the PubUserId parameter or the PubCallIdList parameter, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
发布端用户ID。
> PubUserId和PubCallIdList参数只能二选一输入
parameters.name: pub_user_id

parameters.help_en:
Call IDs of the publisher's communication streams, separated by English commas (,).  
> You must specify either PubUserId or PubCallIdList, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
发布端用户通信流的Call ID，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> PubUserId和PubCallIdList参数只能二选一输入
parameters.name: pub_call_id_list

parameters.help_en: Enumeration list of Metrics, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 指标枚举列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: metrics
